comment: Single source of truth for the FliHub capability catalog. Consumed by the SvelteKit app (src/lib/capabilities/catalog.ts) and by the PocketBase hooks (pb_hooks/flihub_capabilities.pb.js) via a shared JSON require — do not fork this list.

templates.label: League
templates.description: Suggested capabilities for league play with teams and seasons. Available scoring and standings currently use golf rules.

templates.label: Race/Event
templates.description: Distance-event configuration with suggested capabilities. Race timing and race results are not implemented; available scoring uses golf rules.

templates.label: Custom
templates.description: Choose capabilities individually. Custom setup does not add new entry types or result methods.

capabilities.label: Athletes
capabilities.description: Sport-neutral athlete records for your organization.

capabilities.label: Teams & rosters
capabilities.description: Teams, season rosters, and reserve pools.

capabilities.label: Venues & courses
capabilities.description: Golf course layouts with holes and positions. General venue records are planned.

capabilities.label: Events
capabilities.description: Standalone or season-linked events with golf rounds and group assignments.

capabilities.label: Scoring & official results
capabilities.description: Golf stroke entry and submission with Owner/Admin official-result approval, publication, and versioned corrections. Timing, match scoring, and judging are not implemented.

capabilities.label: Competition standings
capabilities.description: Golf competition standings from published official stroke totals; lowest complete total leads.

capabilities.label: Fantasy leagues
capabilities.description: Private fantasy leagues with per-event snake drafts and event standings from published golf results. Scores use strokes minus saved par; lowest complete total wins.
